oneLine: TA Associates-backed OmniActive explores $200-300 million IPO at $1 bn valuation.

sources.title: TA Associates-backed OmniActive explores $200-300 million IPO at $1 bn valuation

synopsis: OmniActive Health Technologies Ltd, led by Sanjaya Mariwala, has begun discussions with bankers to explore an initial public offering to raise $200-300 million and value the company at nearly $1 billion. The planned public offering could involve a mix of fresh capital issuance and an offer for sale by existing majority investor TA Associates, which held about a 56% stake as of September 2025, and the Mariwala family, which owned a 40% stake. The IPO discussions are currently at an exploratory stage following unsuccessful attempts to raise private capital.
